Messages.Author: Zazbar
Messages.Body:
How does Smiling Jack the Anarch actually work?

If I played Smiling Jack do I have to put one on him each turn?

Would I have to put one blood on him the turn he came into play?
I don't think so because he came in after my untap phase.

Then no one would have to pay the first turn he comes out?

Just some silly questions...

Zazbar

Messages.Author: Robert Ekvall
Messages.Body:
How does Smiling Jack the Anarch actually work?

You put one pool each of your untap phases on the Anarch and everyone
else must burn one pool or blood for each blood on the anarch.

If I played Smiling Jack do I have to put one on him each turn?

Yes.

Would I have to put one blood on him the turn he came into play?
I don't think so because he came in after my untap phase.

No.

Then no one would have to pay the first turn he comes out?

Right.

Robert
